name: Nachtkrapp
description: A folkloric nocturnal bird-like creature of Germanic and Central European tradition, invoked chiefly to frighten children into obedience and bed. Reports cluster in southern Germany and Austria, with related figures across northern Germany, Hungary, Poland, and Sweden.

aliases.name: Nattramn
aliases.meaning: night raven; ghost of an unbaptized child or unholy burial

origin: Primarily attested in southern Germany and Austria, with cognate figures across northern Germany, Central Europe (Hungary, Poland), and Sweden.
